name: Infrastructure apply guard
summary: Block direct infrastructure and cluster state mutation commands while allowing planning operations.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate that distinguishes read-only plan and diff operations from mutating Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, kubectl, and Helm subcommands.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks direct infrastructure and cluster state mutation commands while allowing planning operations; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not apply, destroy, import, or roll back infrastructure.
It does not infer an environment from a prompt, variable, account, or workspace name.
It does not treat a dry-run-like custom flag as proof of safety.

entrypoints.purpose: Classify infrastructure CLI subcommands and refuse those that mutate managed state.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block direct infrastructure and cluster state mutation commands while allowing planning operations without deferred work.
